models.scope: Normal-condition full-month employee; whole-leu monthly input; main job by default, declared total eligible dependants and school-child/youth eligibility; basic salary defaults to gross; minimum relief assumes full-time eligibility and no disqualifying pay reduction; CAM employer cost
models.arithmetic: Whole-leu monthly contribution/deduction/tax rounding, half up; annual fields project twelve identical selected-rule months, not calendar-year settlement; lowest exact-net whole-leu inverse across every relief/deduction interval

models.scope: Same normal-condition full-month and declared eligibility profile as H1; whole-leu monthly input, deductions and employer CAM cost
models.arithmetic: Whole-leu monthly contribution/deduction/tax rounding, half up; annual fields project twelve identical selected-rule months, not calendar-year settlement; lowest exact-net whole-leu inverse across every relief/deduction interval

models.wageTaxProgram: BMF Programmablaufplan 2026 (BMF-Schreiben 12.11.2025, IV C 5 - S 2361/00025/016/028, BStBl 2025 I S. 1948, Anlage 1); Lohnsteuer2026.xml version 1.0, Stand 2025-10-23, SHA-256 63d8981646d139eba2f4dd990c13b43c4fb3883b402a5a40cddf253aa7aa96b4
models.scope: Current wage (laufender Arbeitslohn) of an employee in statutory pension, unemployment, health and care insurance; tax classes I-VI, declared child allowances (ZKF), care-insurance children (under 25 assumed for discounts), full kassenindividueller Zusatzbeitrag (default 2026 average), Saxony care split, optional 8%/9% church tax; monthly gross above 2000 EUR or annual gross above 24000 EUR; no Minijob/Uebergangsbereich, private insurance, Versorgungsbezuege, age relief, tax-card allowances, factor method, sonstige Bezuege, levies or employer cost
models.arithmetic: Monthly input runs one PAP payroll period (LZZ 2) with monthly ceilings; annual input runs the annual table (LZZ 1) with annual ceilings; wage tax/solidarity/church base per PAP; employee contribution shares half up to cents per branch; church tax truncated to cents; lowest whole-cent exact-net inverse with a bounded rounding-dip scan

models.scope: Full-month employee; whole-forint monthly gross; declared mothers exemption, under-25, first-marriage and family allowance (claimed in full by this person) in statutory order; family contribution relief; employer szocho cost; no benefits, cafeteria, part-month, disability allowance, employer reliefs or minimum-base cases
models.arithmetic: Each amount rounded half up to whole forints; yearly amounts are twelve identical months; lowest whole-forint exact-net inverse with a 3 HUF rounding-dip bound

models.scope: Whole insured tax year, revenue earned evenly; main occupation (monthly minimum base, optional guaranteed minimum), secondary beside 36-hour employment/full-time study, or pensioner; declared allowances applied annually; net before actual costs, HIPA, VAT and chamber fees; no suspension, sick pay or part-year activity; activity-code eligibility for 80%/90% is declared
models.arithmetic: Quarterly cumulative (gongyolites) contribution bases per NAV booklet 100; monthly contributions and annual SZJA/relief rounded half up to whole forints; lowest whole-forint exact-net revenue inverse with a 40 HUF rounding-dip bound
